$comment: Source registry. One entry per source. `runtime` picks the stack; `format` picks the output writer. `schema` points at schemas/<name>.schema.json.

example_api.description: Example API source (Python). Replace with a real one.

example_scrape.description: Example scrape source (Node). Reuses the example schema for now.

massive_grouped_daily.description: Massive.com grouped daily bars for the US stocks market (one row per ticker per day).

massive_tickers_cs.description: Massive.com common stocks (type CS), listed and delisted: the massive-ext universe.

massive_treasury_yields.description: Massive.com US Treasury yields (/fed/v1/treasury-yields), daily; each fetch file is a vintage.

massive_inflation.description: Massive.com US inflation (/fed/v1/inflation), monthly; each fetch file is a vintage.

massive_shares.description: Quarter-end point-in-time market cap and share counts per CS/ADRC ticker (/v3/reference/tickers/{T}?date=).

massive_extended_hours.description: Pre-market / after-hours prices and volumes per common stock per day, from Massive 1-min bars (sourcing-py massive-ext).
